Components / Shell

Notification bell

.dr-bell · .dr-count-badge · components/shell.css · components/badge.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

3
  1. 1.dr-bellThe control: a 44 × 44 link with a transparent ground, margin-right: -10px so the glyph lands 17.8px from the frame edge, mirroring the back chevron.
  2. 2.dr-bell .dr-icThe bell glyph at the 22px rung, --text-primary on --bg-page, 15.99:1.
  3. 3.dr-count-badgeThe unread count: an 18px pill, 11/600, --on-action on --color-action, 9.46:1, set 4 from the box's top and right. aria-hidden; the link's name speaks the number.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Notification bell.

States

Light

Dark

Try it: hover, press, Tab. Follows the theme switch above.

3

From listings.

When to use

The bell is the whole entrance to the alert log (notifications, operator-notifications), and it stands on the two home screens and nowhere else: 5 pages, the four listings pages and operator-listings. The screens split on the operator side: operator-listings draws the bell, and its empty state operator-listings-empty draws the same bar without it. It is .dr-back mirrored and not one number in it is new: the same 44 × 44 box, 22px glyph, focus ring and 10px pull to the gutter. HIG · 44pt 100%, WCAG 2.5.8 1.83×.

The count is spoken, not only shown: aria-label="Notifications, 3 unread" carries the number and the pill is aria-hidden, so WCAG 4.1.2 is met and WCAG 1.4.1 is never engaged. The pill is a status mark, not a green control: 324px², 0.106% of the frame.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The notification bell · ui/kit.html § Nav bar · operator home · inventory.md § 1 (Notification bell)

Rule and anti-rule

Do

3

A bare glyph at the trailing edge of a home bar, named with its count.

Don’t

A filled disc in the nav bar. No bar in the product holds one: HIG · Navigation bars puts a glyph or a word in the bar, and every trailing control built so far is unfilled. The circular action belongs in content and on photographs; in the bar, use .dr-bell. A count that names the screen's own unread rows belongs on the row as a New chip, as in the alerts log.
